adoption_certificate.content_key_algorithm: sha256 over canonical JSON of the certificate minus content_key
adoption_certificate.produced_by: post-review adoption task (never by a campaign run)

authorizes: nothing by itself: this contract defines the seam. No gate record and no adoption certificate exist for v5, and none is created by this task.
binding_rules: both artifacts must be regular, non-symlink files; a symlink is refused rather than followed
certificate key set must be exact; unknown or missing fields are fatal
certificate content_key must recompute over its own canonical body
gate record byte length AND sha256 must equal the certificate's binding
the manifest named by the certificate must production-validate and its content key must equal the certificate's
the campaign must not be in REJECTED_CAMPAIGNS
every manifest source_fingerprint must still match the live repository file
gate record key set must be exact; identity fields must agree with BOTH certificate and manifest
required/completed/case_count must all equal the frozen manifest case count
thresholds must equal the production threshold set (manifest gate + minimum_ranking_case_fraction)
gate_checks key set must be exact for the frozen gate; every check must be true
metric key set must be exactly the producer's; values must satisfy their declared domains
every numerically-derivable check is RECOMPUTED from metrics and thresholds and must agree
gate_status must be pass and both claim flags true
fail_closed: any absence, alteration, unknown field, earlier campaign, incomplete run or mismatch returns None; the product then uses bounded-exhaustive screening and forbids UI/global-best claims
purpose: Adoption of a monthly held-out gate requires TWO independent artifacts. The gate record alone is self-certifying: it asserts its own campaign identity, so a byte-level edit to any metric, threshold or claim flag still validated against itself. A post-review adoption certificate binds the record's exact bytes together with the frozen manifest identity and the bounded claim scope.
thresholds_rule: record thresholds must equal EXACTLY the production evaluator's set: the frozen manifest gate PLUS manifest.minimum_ranking_case_fraction. Equality with manifest['gate'] alone is WRONG and would make every real gate_record_for() record unadoptable.
